description.text:
The supervised stage of a Constitutional AI reproduction ([Bai et al. 2022](https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.08073)): Qwen3-4B-Instruct fine-tuned on its own self-critiqued, revised answers to red-team prompts, against a 5-principle constitution adapted from public sources (the CAI paper and Anthropic's published constitution). LoRA SFT, merged. Code + full writeup: https://github.com/shipbehaves/constitutional-cai

On a two-axis eval this stage raises over-refusal on benign prompts from 0.327 to 0.431 while safety stays ~1.0. It is published for reproducibility and failure analysis, not as a general-purpose model. See the repo for the stage-by-stage teardown of the harmless-vs-overrefusal tension.

serving.text_only_input_quote: prompt = "Give me a short introduction to large language model."
serving.notes: The quote for text-only input is the parent card's quickstart (Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507); this card has no usage example. tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key. The template file inserts a system turn only when the caller supplies one. config.json max_position_embeddings is 262144; tokenizer model_max_length is 1010000.

evaluation_reported.text: On a two-axis eval this stage raises over-refusal on benign prompts from 0.327 to 0.431 while safety stays ~1.0. The GitHub table names this repo as SL-CAI: safe on harmful 1.000, over-refusal on benign 0.431. Benchmarks stated there: StrongREJECT and hh-rlhf harmless-base test for safety; XSTest-safe and OR-Bench-hard for over-refusal.

discrepancies: Inventory methods include rlhf. This checkpoint is the supervised stage only (LoRA SFT, merged). The GitHub README puts RLAIF DPO on sibling repos yavuz-ai/qwen3-4b-cai-rlaif and yavuz-ai/qwen3-4b-cai-rlaif-v2. The card tag rlaif is not a sentence about how this checkpoint was trained. The SFT script loads yavuz-ai/cai-sft (4,804 self-revisions). Anthropic/hh-rlhf is the prompt source (harmless-base), which the inventory lists, and the parent matches.
